title: 警报声无法关闭且令人烦躁
description: 接近警报等警报声持续响起，无法通过拆除模块或对接等方式关闭，且声音刺耳、令人烦躁。
evidence: A proximity alarm that wont stay muted even if you rip out the alarm module on the Nav Station you're linked to.
some of the sounds in this game are also kinda horrific, like proximity alarms that will not shut down when docked
the most annoying high pitched, fast, loud, and incessant beeping noise with zero indication of how to stop it

evidence_items.quote: A proximity alarm that wont stay muted even if you rip out the alarm module on the Nav Station you're linked to.
evidence_items.description: 即使拆除导航站上的警报模块，接近警报也无法保持静音
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个接近警报，即使你拆掉你所连接导航站上的警报模块，它也不会保持静音。

evidence_items.quote: the most annoying high pitched, fast, loud, and incessant beeping noise with zero indication of how to stop it
evidence_items.description: 持续刺耳的高音警报声，无法停止
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最烦人的高音调、快速、响亮、持续不断的哔哔声，完全没有任何提示告诉你如何停止它
